title: Label-misread feedback row (A72 pedagogy, H6465)
description: One lightweight row per misread dictionary label, collected through the optional onboarding guide (docs/A72_LABEL_READING_GUIDE.ru.md) during community review-pool work. Rows live in the gitignored review/ tree only; an aggregated roll-up is what reaches the repository and is routed back to the E3 small-class register follow-up (csl-standards). No personal data: the annotator is a pool pseudonym (pool-aNN), never a name or contact; free-text notes are subject to the same contact-scrub rule as review-pool exports (docs/REVIEW_POOL_V1_DESIGN.md §4.5).

feedbackId.description: Opaque unique row id, e.g. lmf-<uuid4>.

guideLabel.description: The abbreviation string as printed in the guide, e.g. "c." or "P.". Should be a label section of docs/A72_LABEL_READING_GUIDE.ru.md; labels marked «нет в цензе» are especially valuable feedback.

sheetId.description: Optional: the review-pool sheet the feedback arose during, e.g. csl-atlas-r2-checkpoint_10rows. Omit for standalone guide reading.

packetId.description: Optional: pool packet context (r2-checkpoint | h4-semantic-field | xref-shared-core | none).

annotator.description: Pseudonymous pool annotator id only — 152-ФЗ: no names, e-mails, handles.

expectedExpansion.description: What the reader expected the label to mean, in their own words.

censusExpansion.description: The expansion the reader actually met, quoted verbatim from the census legend row; empty when the label is «not in census».

censusSource.description: Where the reader met the expansion: the generated guide, data/abbrev/abbrev_census.json, a dictionary preface, or elsewhere.

createdAt.description: UTC date only (coarsened per the pool identity rule, §4).

note.description: Optional free text. Contact-bearing tokens (e-mail, @handle, t.me/ link, bare URL) are refused before storage, same as review-pool export notes (§4.5).
